risk_summary: The excerpt is highly detailed and quantitatively supported, with strong revenue and operating performance presented across regions and product groups. It acknowledges geopolitical, macroeconomic, demand, pricing, and recession risks, but generally frames them as manageable and maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook. Forward-looking projections rely on broad customer surveys and conditional assumptions, limiting certainty around 2012 performance.
